Loading faculty registry…

No fixed faculty-count limit in the UI

No faculties found

Linked academic structure: department, program, student and teaching-faculty totals are calculated from linked records, not manually typed in the Faculty form.
Leadership history: changing a Dean updates the current appointment while preserving the previous appointment and tenure record.
Master-data audit: important faculty edits keep a lightweight history of what changed, when it changed and who changed it.
Lifecycle-safe: faculty records are not hard-deleted. Use Inactive when a faculty is closed or archived so leadership and administrative history remain available for audit. Backend later enforces the same faculty ID + campus ID lifecycle.
Scales with the university: the registry is data-driven, not hard-coded to a fixed number of cards. Add as many faculty master records as the campus actually has; search, sorting, filters and pagination keep large registries such as 100–180+ faculties usable.

Department Directory

Loading department registry…

Dean/HOD portals feed this report

No departments found

Department structure belongs to Dean
Final authority chain: University Admin creates Faculty + appoints Dean → Dean creates/manages Departments + appoints HOD → HOD manages Department operations → University Admin receives read-only reports.
Dean Portal: the Dean assigns/organizes Departments under the Faculty and manages lower Faculty roles. Admin only sees the resulting hierarchy/report.
HOD Portal: after the Dean appoints the HOD, the HOD assigns lower Department roles/staff and manages Department academic work. Admin only reads the resulting report.
Students: enrollment/admission remains outside Departments; counts are linked/read-only.
History: HOD changes made by the Dean, Faculty structure changes and delegated source updates preserve actor and date for Admin audit.

JuniCore routes the request to the operational owner: Attendance → HOD/department attendance records, Exams/Results → Exam Controller, Registration/Student Records → Registrar, Programs/Courses → HOD, Compliance → Quality Assurance, Finance → Accountant, Admissions → Admission Staff, while complete Faculty academic reports and workload reports go to the Dean. Every route keeps a full audit trail.
